```{=html}
<style>
  .theme-bar { position: fixed; top: 10px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 50; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px;
    justify-content: center; max-width: 70vw; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15); font: 600 13px/1 "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; }
  .theme-bar button { border: 1px solid #d6dee8; background: #fff; border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
  .theme-bar button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #003477; color: #fff; border-color: #003477; }
  .theme-bar .dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.2); }
  .theme-bar .mine::after { content: "mine"; font-size: 10px; opacity: .7; }
  html.print-pdf .theme-bar { display: none; }
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  // Every colour scheme the page knows (Chalkline's, and the course's own from brand/themes/), as buttons
  const CHALKLINE = ["night", "sky", "lagoon", "sunrise"];
  function start() {
    const names = [];
    [].forEach.call(document.styleSheets, function (sheet) {
      let rules; try { rules = sheet.cssRules; } catch (e) { return; }
      [].forEach.call(rules || [], function (r) {
        (r.selectorText || "").replace(/\.scheme-([a-z0-9-]+)/g, function (m, n) { if (names.indexOf(n) < 0) names.push(n); });
      });
    });
    const reveal = document.querySelector(".reveal"), bar = document.createElement("div");
    bar.className = "theme-bar";
    const probe = document.createElement("div"); reveal.appendChild(probe);
    function set(name) {
      [].slice.call(reveal.classList).forEach(function (c) { if (c.indexOf("scheme-") === 0) reveal.classList.remove(c); });
      if (name) reveal.classList.add("scheme-" + name);
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--r-background-color", getComputedStyle(reveal).getPropertyValue("--paper").trim() || "#fff");
      document.querySelectorAll(".reveal .slides section").forEach(function (s) { if (window.ChalklineSchemes) ChalklineSchemes.paint(s); });
      bar.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.name === name)); });
      Reveal.layout();
    }
    [""].concat(names).forEach(function (n) {
      probe.className = n ? "scheme-" + n : "";
      const b = document.createElement("button"), d = document.createElement("span");
      d.className = "dot"; d.style.background = getComputedStyle(probe).getPropertyValue("--paper").trim() || "#fff";
      b.dataset.name = n; b.append(d, n ? n.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + n.slice(1) : "Default");
      if (n && CHALKLINE.indexOf(n) < 0) b.classList.add("mine");
      b.onclick = function () { set(n); };
      bar.appendChild(b);
    });
    probe.remove();
    document.body.appendChild(bar);
    set("");
  }
  function go() { if (Reveal.isReady()) start(); else Reveal.on("ready", start); }
  if (window.Reveal) go(); else window.addEventListener("load", go);   // this script comes before reveal.js
})();
</script>
```
